<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Slam Down](/Feats.aspx?ID=4794) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fighter" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=601" />
<trait label="Flourish" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=73" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 143

**Archetypes** [Mauler](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=68) (Level 4), [Thlipit Contestant](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=224) (Level 6)

**Prerequisites**
Trained in [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3)

</column>

---

You make an attack to knock a foe off balance, then follow up immediately with a sweep to topple them. Make a melee Strike. If it hits and deals damage, you can attempt an Athletics check to Trip the creature you hit. If you’re wielding a two-handed melee weapon, you can ignore Trip’s requirement that you have a hand free. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn’t increase until after you’ve made both of them.

<title level="2">Slam Down leads to...</title>
[Crashing Slam](/Feats.aspx?ID=4821)
name: Slam Down
